mapper.select: SELECT postType, postNo, viewNo, title, userId, writerName, writerRole, createdAt, hit FROM ( SELECT 'NOTICE' AS postType, q.QNA_NO AS postNo, 0 AS viewNo, q.QNA_TITLE AS title, q.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, TO_CHAR(q.QNA_CREATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, NVL(q.QNA_HIT, 0) AS hit FROM QNA_BOARD q JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = q.USER_ID WHERE q.IS_NOTICE = 'Y' AND NVL(q.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY q.QNA_CREATED DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{value}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT q.QNA_NO AS postNo FROM QNA_BOARD q JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = q.USER_ID WHERE q.IS_NOTICE = 'N' AND NVL(q.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND q.QNA_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
AND (q.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%' OR u.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%')
AND q.QNA_CTT LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT r.REVIEW_NO AS postNo FROM REVIEW_BOARD r JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE NVL(r.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND r.REVIEW_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
AND (r.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%' OR u.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%')
AND r.REVIEW_CTT LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
)

SELECT postType, postNo, viewNo, title, userId, writerName, writerRole, TO_CHAR(createdAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, hit FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, X.* FROM ( SELECT postType, postNo, viewNo, title, userId, writerName, writerRole, createdAt, hit FROM (
SELECT 'QNA' AS postType, q.QNA_NO AS postNo, (COUNT(*) OVER () - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q.QNA_CREATED DESC, q.QNA_NO DESC) + 1) AS viewNo, q.QNA_TITLE AS title, q.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, q.QNA_CREATED AS createdAt, NVL(q.QNA_HIT, 0) AS hit FROM QNA_BOARD q JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = q.USER_ID WHERE q.IS_NOTICE = 'N' AND NVL(q.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND q.QNA_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
AND (q.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%' OR u.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%')
AND q.QNA_CTT LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'REVIEW' AS postType, r.REVIEW_NO AS postNo, (COUNT(*) OVER () - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.REVIEW_CREATED DESC, r.REVIEW_NO DESC) + 1) AS viewNo, r.REVIEW_TITLE AS title, r.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole, r.REVIEW_CREATED AS createdAt, NVL(r.REVIEW_HIT, 0) AS hit FROM REVIEW_BOARD r JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE NVL(r.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND r.REVIEW_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
AND (r.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%' OR u.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%')
AND r.REVIEW_CTT LIKE '%' || #{svo.sword} || '%'
) ORDER BY createdAt DESC, postNo DESC ) X WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rnum >= #{start}
